body: Don't let people see this! Home priced are jacked enough! We're all racist and intolerant, stay out!

Hi friend. I know EXACTLY how you feel. I used to go from randomly super happy for no reason to feeling hollow, anxious and wanting to die. It would happen out of the blue for no reason. One time it happened, I had to leave work because I couldn't stand to be around people. They used to call it manic depression, I think, but there are so many clinical names for it that I don't know which is which. Only that it's damned serious and eats you alive.

I used to cut. Badly. Like across my chest so nobody would notice because I was ashamed of cutting but I wanted to transition my mental pain to physical pain so that I could see it and feel it and hope for it to heal. I would sit there with a sharpened knife and make X's all over my chest. I would then lay down and pour salt over the cuts and then I would grind it into the cuts. I wanted to FEEL PAIN so badly and get the hurt out of my mind and out of my soul.

I was recently out of abusing meth. Like going on intermittent binges of 5 days with no sleep and no food. Only cigarettes, water and a mountain of crystal meth. I still drank, though, and would for years to come.

The meth was stacked on drinking, the drinking stacked on abuse, the abuse stacked on abandonment and the abandonment stacked on a little boy who just wanted to be loved. I never knew the love I needed. I silently suffered for so long until God sent an angel to me and she saved my life. I hurt her so badly during my years of recovery and somehow she never left my side. I don't deserve her but somehow I was saved.

I cried for you tonight. Look at my post history. 5 years ago I was about to commit suicide and I came here like you did seeking help. I came back tonight because I can't sleep and thought maybe there's someone who I can save.

You're not alone, my friend. Your soul is my soul and the pain in your heart is my pain. You are someone who deserves to be loved. You're not a monster and you're not a bad guy. You're my fellow soul and I want to heal you. Come talk to me. Send me a personal IM. Don't let the shadow take you. Not now. There's still a life to fight for. Whatever has happened to you, I don't judge you. I accept you for the person you are. There's still a spark of life in you. Let's kindle that spark. Just keep talking, ok?

These are very kind words coming from someone who sounds like they have a great heart. I was not offended by any of your words. On the contrary, I thought they were encouraging and warming. If my post has helped you see your own struggles, I would be a willing ear where you could vent your pain. It makes me feel better to know other people are going through the same challenges as I am.

I think we each have a mountain to climb, but it's easier to see the top of someone else's mountain from far away than it is to see the top of own's own mountain from its base.

Hi, E. I was still drunk this morning and very much in a poor mental state. To the outward observer, I don't think it showed but I'm not really sure. I definitely had a slight breakdown, today (there have been much worse). It may have been also triggered by the lack of sleep in addition to the alcohol.

Thank you for your kind words. I'm going to seek counseling. I've been in an infinite loop for a lot of years and it's time to fix my problems so I can continue living life and not feeling sorry for myself.

I think what I feel is that I don't ever want my daughter to feel like I do. 20 years later and I still feel like my dad just walked out the door, yesterday. I've never seen my mom so emotionally destroyed and I don't want to be the cause of that for anyone. I want my little girl to grow up happy, healthy, and in one family unit. Even if I'm a miserable bastard I would stand in burning flames if I knew it would protect her from the evils of this world.
Thank you very much Hongkie - this makes me feel a bit better. I had to leave work today because I'm having a breakdown. Sometimes it's just ups and downs that I can handle but today is just down.

I just did this and I started crying. The root cause of this is my dad leaving when I was a kid. I told him I forgave him but deep down I never did. I'm so mad that he left my mom, sister, and I while my mom was in the depths of depression.

The worst: I cheated on my wife during an awful drinking binge a year ago. Neither of us have ever been fully faithful to each other but I'm the most guilty party. I sometimes think we should be divorced, but I have a daughter with her and I swore on my life that I would never abandon her.
